newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tysan shareholders approve China deal.
newsitem.headline: Tysan shareholders approve China deal.

text.p: Tysan Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its shareholders had approved the company's agreement to raise its stake in Consco Investment Co Ltd to 58.25 percent from 31.25 percent.

The foundation works and construction concern said it would be able to gain controlling interest in Tianjin International Building, a commercial and residential complex in Tianjin in northeastern China, through the shareholding.
Tysan said the building generates gross annual rental income of about US$15 million.

Tysan said the purchase, which is to be financed by net proceeds of HK$106 million from the sale of its investment property in Quarry Bay in Hong Kong, would not affect the company's existing gearing ratio as no borrowing was required.
In December, Tysan said it would buy an 80 percent stake in Consco Holdings, which indirectly holds an interest in the Tianjin property, from China United Holdings Ltd.
